capabilities: Render the vault as an interactive 3D force graph
Auto-cluster nodes by folder, tag, attachment, and unresolved link
Fly through the graph with auto-orbit, rotate, zoom, and pan controls
Adjust force simulation and visual settings
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Part of the agentage Memory ecosystem, but the Memory cloud service is a separate, optional product; the plugin itself makes zero network calls. Desktop only (WebGL/three.js); roadmap includes Canvas file support and saved camera layouts.
intentEvidence: It's the built-in graph view, in 3D - the same node kinds and the same filters
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view is flat 2D and requires hand-written filter groups, with no 3D navigation or automatic clustering.

relations.evidence: It's part of agentage Memory - a shared memory layer for every AI
The companion Agentage Sync plugin keeps your vault in sync with your private memory

summary: 3D force-graph view that renders the vault as a rotating, fly-through galaxy of note nodes colored by folder.
